facts.fact: ST110 is the diff cover station — the station where the expansion plug is inserted. 'Diff cover station' is the shop-floor name for it; on the facility map it is labelled 'ST110 · Brake & Cover' (Stage 2), and its MES phases cover the expanding plug, the bearing cone and the LH differential carrier assembly.
facts.applies_when: when asked which station is the diff cover station, or where the expansion plug is inserted

citation.transcript_quote: Diff cover station (ST110) where the expansion plug is inserted (and where we will install cameras).

facts.fact: ST110 (diff cover) is the station where cameras will be installed — the next station targeted for vision coverage after the ST100 pinion guide pilot. This is a plan, not a live deployment: there is no procedure knowledge base, component library or glasses build for ST110 yet, so only its historical MES data can be cited for that station today.
facts.applies_when: when asked where cameras are going in, or which station is next for vision coverage after the pinion guide
